ownership: agent-authored qualification criteria for the independently chosen test scene
scoring_policy: partial_is_fail; obscured, unavailable, or blocked pixel evidence is unscored, never pass
test_concept: McBling gift packing in a home sewing corner beside a balcony door

gates.pass: Pink velour garment and visible rhinestone embellishment co-occur on the adult, together with at least two of low-rise flared denim, rhinestone belt, large hoop earrings, metallic silver shoulder bag.
gates.fail: Only a generic pink or glitter cue is visible, or the required co-occurring signals are missing.
gates.unscored: Garments or accessories are too small, obscured, or absent from view to evaluate.

gates.pass: The low waistband and flared denim leg silhouette are visibly legible with the pink zip hoodie.
gates.fail: The visible jeans are high-waisted or straight/tapered, or the outfit changes the independently selected silhouette.
gates.unscored: The waistline or legs are occluded or cropped.

gates.pass: One adult uses the right hand to place a recognizable beaded bracelet inside the open tissue-lined box while the left hand stabilizes its near rim.
gates.fail: The object floats, rests away from the box, has changed owner or lacks the chosen placement/support relation.
gates.unscored: Either hand or the box interior is consequentially hidden.

gates.pass: A sewing corner beside a balcony is visible with filled gift boxes, current partly filled box, bead tray and at least two of ribbon, fabric offcuts, unplugged hairdryer, tangled charger cable.
gates.fail: The event becomes an unrelated clean portrait or the domestic preparation traces are missing.
gates.unscored: The work surface or location cannot be assessed.

gates.pass: Both hands visibly belong to the adult, wrist-finger chains and object contacts are plausible, the seated adult has stable chair/floor support.
gates.fail: Anatomical ownership, impossible reach, unsupported body or contradictory contact is visible.
gates.unscored: The mechanism is too occluded or blurred to inspect.

gates.pass: The subject is an explicitly adult realization with visible dark bob or fine fringe and soft facial contour/glossy lips that reflect appearance guidance from the supplied image.
gates.fail: The generated subject visibly disregards the reference components.
gates.unscored: The face or hair cannot be meaningfully inspected.
gates.boundary: This is component guidance only, not identity, age verification, nationality, personality or body-shape matching.
